evaluation: 5 repeated 80/20 GroupShuffleSplit holdouts; groups join >=80% normalized edit identity components and fragments from the same UniProt parent accession
limitations: Putative negatives may contain undiscovered AMPs.
AMP positives and UniProt-derived negative fragments come from different biological sources; source or composition differences may inflate scores.
No independent external test set; exploratory only. Do not interpret high CV scores as validated biological performance.
